question: A circular clock has a radius of 14 cm. Calculate the distance covered by the tip of the minute hand in 30 minutes, assuming it is positioned at the edge of the clock face? (Use π= 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The minute hand covers a complete circle (360°) in 60 minutes.

In 30 minutes, it covers exactly half of the circular path.

Distance covered in 30 minutes = Half of circumference = π × r

Distance = (22/7) × 14 = 44 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 44 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the clock face (r) = 14 cm

Time duration = 30 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Arc length = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

Angle covered by minute hand in 1 minute = 360° ÷ 60 = 6°

**Calculations:**

⇒ Angle covered in 30 minutes (θ) = 30 × 6° = 180°

⇒ Arc length = (180° ÷ 360°) × 2 × (22/7) × 14

⇒ Arc length = (1/2) × 2 × 22 × 2

⇒ Arc length = 1 × 44 = 44 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 44 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The region bounded by two radii and an arc is called a sector. Formula: Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr².

Speed of Clock Hands

The minute hand moves at a speed of 6° per minute, while the hour hand moves at 0.5° per minute.

Circumference of a Circle

The total boundary length of a circular path is its circumference. Formula: C = 2πr or C = πd.
